name: cell-ppt
description: Draw reconstructed scientific figures as editable native PowerPoint objects with live text.

interface.longDescription: Cell_ppt draws scientific reference images and SVG files as editable native PowerPoint paths and live text from bottom to top while protecting existing slide content. WPS support is experimental.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Cell_ppt to reconstruct my uploaded scientific figure as editable native objects in the current PowerPoint slide.
